acceptance: Each test passes 50 runs under `-count=50` beside a parallel full-suite run.
The fix names the cause of each flake in its commit message.
fix: Reproduce each one under full-suite load with full -v output (for example `go test -count=20 -run '<Test>$' ./<pkg>` beside a parallel full run). Find the shared cause: a real-time deadline, a shared temp path, a port or a file watcher. Fix the test's own timing or isolation; never weaken an assertion and never add a retry.
source: console, 2026-10-17: full-suite runs of five console lanes (O2b, C0b, O7, the K1 fix, the Argon routing change)
summary: On 2026-10-17, each of these tests failed once in a full `go test -count=1 ./...` run and passed when run alone and on a package rerun: TestChannelE2E_RealFixtures_ClaudeSpan (go/internal/bridge/channel_e2e_test.go, O2b lane) and TestSyncMain_TheLoopsInboxStampsNeverBlockTheSync (go/cmd/evolve/cmd_syncmain_test.go, O7 commit gate). The O7 gate rejected a commit on the second one. A third test of the first report, TestChannel_EndToEnd, is fixed by #1006 (the phase stream reads stderr before stdout) and is removed from this item (flaky-test census, docs/research/flaky-tests-2026-10.md F4.1).
title: Two tests fail once under full-suite load and pass alone: bridge ClaudeSpan, cmd/evolve SyncMain inbox stamps
